# Implementation Plan - Link to QR Code Generator

Build a modern, client-side web application for generating QR codes from URLs based on the provided Product Requirements Document (PRD).

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The app will be built using Vanilla HTML5, modern CSS3 (custom sleek design system, responsive glassmorphism/neumorphism touches, smooth animations), and pure JavaScript with a standalone, reliable client-side QR generation engine (`qrcodejs`/canvas-based).

## Proposed Changes

### Frontend Application Structure

#### [NEW] [index.html](file:///d:/AI%202/QR%20Code%20generator/index.html)
- Semantic HTML5 structure with modern metadata and responsive viewport settings.
- Header with branding ("Link to QR Code") and concise subtitle.
- Card-based generator interface containing:
  - Input group with clear/paste button and URL icon.
  - Error message container for dynamic, accessible alerts.
  - Action button: "Generate QR Code".
  - Result area (initially hidden, animated on reveal):
    - QR preview card (crisp canvas/image representation).
    - URL display badge with click-to-copy convenience.
    - Actions: "Download QR" (`qr-code.png`) and "Create New" (reset).
- Footer with lightweight branding and client-side privacy notice.

#### [NEW] [css/style.css](file:///d:/AI%202/QR%20Code%20generator/css/style.css)
- Premium design system:
  - Curated color palette (modern slate/indigo/violet gradients, dark/light contrast, vibrant accent buttons).
  - Typography using Google Fonts (Plus Jakarta Sans / Inter).
  - Smooth micro-interactions, floating glowing backdrop effects, card hover states, and smooth slide/fade animations for state transitions.
  - Fully responsive layout for mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

#### [NEW] [js/qrcode.min.js](file:///d:/AI%202/QR%20Code%20generator/js/qrcode.min.js)
- Standalone, offline-ready JavaScript QR code generation library to ensure zero backend dependency and 100% client-side privacy and availability.

#### [NEW] [js/app.js](file:///d:/AI%202/QR%20Code%20generator/js/app.js)
- Application logic fulfilling all PRD Functional Requirements (FR-01 through FR-06):
  - **FR-01 (Input URL)**: Handles user input, Enter key trigger, and automatic trim.
  - **FR-02 (Validasi URL)**: Validates URL format (protocols `http://`, `https://`, or domain-like formats auto-normalized). Displays exact PRD error messages (`"Silakan masukkan URL."` and `"URL tidak valid. Silakan masukkan link yang benar."`).
  - **FR-03 & FR-04 (Generate & Preview)**: Generates high-resolution QR code and transitions to preview state displaying QR Code and target URL.
  - **FR-05 (Download QR Code)**: Triggers client-side download as high-res PNG named `qr-code.png`.
  - **FR-06 (Reset)**: Resets input, clears state and returns smoothly to initial view.

## Verification Plan

### Automated / Browser Verification
- Open the application in browser using `browser_subagent`.
- Test Empty Input validation -> verify message `"Silakan masukkan URL."`.
- Test Invalid URL validation (e.g. `invalid_url`) -> verify message `"URL tidak valid. Silakan masukkan link yang benar."`.
- Test Valid URL (e.g. `https://example.com`) -> verify QR generated, preview rendered, URL shown.
- Test "Download QR" -> verify download trigger.
- Test "Create New" (Reset) -> verify return to initial empty state.
- Test mobile responsiveness viewport.

# Walkthrough - Link to QR Code Generator

Aplikasi web **Link to QR Code Generator** telah berhasil dibangun dan diuji sesuai dengan seluruh spesifikasi yang tercantum pada [PRD_Link_to_QR_Code_Generator.pdf](file:///d:/AI%202/QR%20Code%20generator/PRD_Link_to_QR_Code_Generator.pdf).

---

## 🚀 Fitur & Implementasi PRD

| PRD Code | Fitur | Status | Deskripsi |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| **FR-01** | Input URL | ✅ Selesai | Input URL dengan placeholder `Masukkan URL, contoh: https://example.com` dan tombol pembersih cepat (*clear button*). |
| **FR-02** | Validasi URL | ✅ Selesai | Validasi otomatis: jika kosong menampilkan `"Silakan masukkan URL."`, jika format salah menampilkan `"URL tidak valid. Silakan masukkan link yang benar."`. |
| **FR-03** | Generate QR Code | ✅ Selesai | Pembuatan QR Code instan berbasis *client-side* (tanpa server) dengan koreksi kesalahan tinggi (*High Error Correction*). |
| **FR-04** | Preview QR Code | ✅ Selesai | Menampilkan QR Code yang dihasilkan, teks target URL, dan tombol cepat salin link (*Copy to clipboard*). |
| **FR-05** | Download QR Code | ✅ Selesai | Mengunduh berkas gambar PNG beresolusi tinggi (1024x1024) dengan nama default `qr-code.png`. |
| **FR-06** | Reset ("Create New") | ✅ Selesai | Mengembalikan aplikasi ke tampilan awal, membersihkan input, error, dan hasil QR. |
| **NFR** | Keamanan & Responsif | ✅ Selesai | 100% Client-side (tidak menyimpan data pengguna), tampilan adaptif di perangkat desktop, tablet, dan smartphone. |

## 📁 Struktur Berkas Proyek

Proyek mengikuti struktur berkas standar sesuai rekomendasi PRD:

```text
QR Code generator/
├── index.html              # Struktur semantic HTML & layout
├── css/
│   └── style.css           # Desain modern, glassmorphism, responsive, dan animasi
├── js/
│   ├── app.js              # Logika aplikasi (FR-01 s/d FR-06)
│   └── qrcode.min.js       # Library QR Code generator mandiri (Client-Side)
├── server.js               # Web server lokal ringan (opsional)
└── PRD_Link_to_QR_Code_Generator.pdf
```

---

## 🛠️ Cara Menjalankan Aplikasi

Aplikasi ini dapat dibuka secara langsung di browser tanpa instalasi backend:

1. **Buka Langsung Berkas HTML**:
   Cukup klik dua kali atau buka berkas [index.html](file:///d:/AI%202/QR%20Code%20generator/index.html) pada browser pilihan Anda (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari).

2. **Menjalankan Melalui Local Server (Node.js)**:
   ```bash
   node server.js
   ```
   Lalu buka `http://localhost:4173/` pada browser.

# Link to QR Code Generator 🚀

Aplikasi web modern, cepat, dan 100% *client-side* untuk mengubah link/URL menjadi gambar QR Code berkualitas tinggi secara instan.

Live Demo: *(akan aktif melalui GitHub Pages)*

---

## ✨ Fitur Utama
- **Input & Validasi Instan**: Validasi otomatis untuk memastikan format link/URL benar.
- **Client-Side Generation**: Pembuatan QR Code langsung di browser pengguna tanpa pengiriman data ke server (privat dan aman).
- **Download PNG Berkualitas Tinggi**: Hasil unduhan QR Code dalam format gambar PNG beresolusi tajam (1024x1024 px) dengan nama default `qr-code.png`.
- **Desain Modern & Responsif**: Tampilan *glassmorphism* modern dengan tipografi Google Fonts (*Plus Jakarta Sans*), nyaman digunakan di Desktop, Tablet, maupun HP.
- **Copy Link Cepat**: Fitur salin link yang dimasukkan hanya dengan satu kali klik.

---

## 📁 Struktur Folder
```text
├── index.html              # Struktur utama antarmuka
├── css/
│   └── style.css           # Desain visual, tema, dan animasi
├── js/
│   ├── app.js              # Logika aplikasi dan validasi
│   └── qrcode.min.js       # Library QR generator client-side
└── README.md
```

---

## 🛠️ Cara Menjalankan Secara Lokal
1. Clone repositori ini atau download sebagai ZIP.
2. Buka berkas `index.html` langsung di browser Anda (tanpa perlu instalasi server atau database).
